title: R’ Abba Mari Betzala’a
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Shmuel, chapter 13; but Hyman traces the statement to Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 7, at the end of halakhah 1, where the reading is Rabbi Abba Mari, the brother of Rabbi Yose.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Krakow 1893 digital Midrash Shmuel 13 paragraph contains abbreviated R’ Abba Mari and the alternatives (Betzala’a...) [brother of R’ Yose...]. Guggenheimer Berakhot 7:1 paragraph 7 fully writes Rabbi Abba Mari, brother of Rabbi Yose. The heading’s Betzala’a remains as supplied; the claim that the statement derives from the Jerusalem Talmud remains Hyman’s account, not a newly established textual genealogy.
